requirement: A targeted check must check only the requested requirement and must fail if that requirement does not exist.
justification: Scenarios: known selected requirement succeeds while another lacks evidence; full check fails; unknown selection fails rather than passing zero checks. run filters discovered requirements then rejects an empty selection, and subprocess tests assert those different statuses. Validated with cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path language-lab-ci/Cargo.toml (20 tests passing). Each cited test uses isolated fixture files and asserts outcomes, not merely the presence of instructions.
